text:
marco: short thread 1f we need a compact pattern for activation leases + seed pruning in airgapped installs. main constraints: limited bandwidth, operator simplicity, safe rollback. ideas?

olivia: suggest lease+fence model: operator obtains ephemeral lease, performs apply, writes fenced marker, gets fence signed (if signer available), then flips activated. if signer missing, mark for manual activation. keeps activation atomic.

devon: agree. also add a small on-disk apply-state per-component (applied|fenced|activated) so restarts can reconcile without scanning whole modelstore. keep it tiny (JSON) to avoid large journals.

tanya: pruning: keep last 2 activation_seq per component by default, tombstone older sequences after 48h. tombstone should not immediately delete blocks mark as tombstoned until GC pass completes.

kevin: content-addressed blocks help prune safely. refcounts stored in a tiny bolt db. GC pass walks tombstoned versions, decrefs blocks, reclaims when count==0. also a dry-run mode to preview reclaimed size.

emily: on USB installs: bundle = manifest.json + chunk-index + shards. manifest must include stable component_id GUIDs and activation_seq. operator verifies chunk checksums and signer chain locally before applying.

marco: what about resume tokens for streaming installs? token should include root hash + applied_chunk_bitmap so resume is provable. make token TTL configurable and operator surface manual-intervention when expired.

olivia: UX: operator UI shows next steps clearly: Preview -> Fetch -> Apply -> Fence -> Activate. each step has tight logs and a single "abort" path that can undo apply until fenced. after fence, manual rollback requires signed revert bundle.

devon: failure case: power loss mid-fence. operator on restart checks fenced marker + lease. if lease expired, it pauses and requires operator to either re-obtain signer or run manual un-fence. document in runbook.

pkg-bot: auto-note: link to incident that motivated this: /incidents/342.

kevin: add metrics: resume_tokens_issued, tombstones_created, gc_bytes_reclaimed, activation_failures. helpful for SRE.

marco: action items: 1) update RFC with lease+fence state machine and tiny statefile schema; 2) define offline bundle layout (manifest+index+shards); 3) sketch refcount DB and GC dry-run API; 4) write runbook for mid-fence recovery. I'll open a branch and post link.

emily: +1. I'll draft offline bundle example and sample manifest schema.

marco: thanks all, posting draft later today :rocket:
